main_topic.h_title: Do I need council approval for a pergola in Sydney?
main_topic.author: https://www.facebook.com/apollopatios/

primary_content.text: Generally speaking, if the proposal for your pergola meets the requirements set out in the State Environmental Planning Policy (Exempt and Compliance Development Codes) 2008, then your proposal would be deemed as exempt development and, therefore, not require council approval. However, with Apollo Patios, you don’t have to worry about navigating the process yourself. Our experienced team will work with you to ensure your pergola meets all council regulations and building codes.

primary_content.text: The best way to determine the pergola cost is to contact Apollo Patios directly to discuss your project. Each pergola is unique, and therefore, the cost will depend on a variety of factors, including size, design, materials and labour.
